target_zone_range.evidence_basis: Travis — UT Plant Resources Center herbarium index includes A. polyanthemos. Other strong records found in McLennan/Erath and farther north-central Texas are outside the project target-zone county list.
target_zone_range.blocking_issue: Need two more exact target-zone counties.
target_zone_range.guardrail: Do not infer local occurrence from statewide Texas nativity.

morphology.look_here_first: White-flowered prickly-poppy of the central/western plains. Confirm with bud/capsule armature and mature fruit rather than relying on white petals alone, because A. albiflora overlaps visually.
